findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Free" above "$0"; "Pro" above "$10"; "Team" above "$40"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.top-1/2 → linear-gradient(rgb(238, 249, 247), rgb(238, 249, 247)), linear-gradient(rgba(40, 184, 148, 0), rgba(40, 184,  | div.absolute.top-1/2 → radial-gradient(circle, rgba(40, 184, 148, 0.15) 0%, rgba(40, 184, 148, 0.08) 45%, rgba(40, 184, 148, 0) 70%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 25 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: ul.absolute.top-[54px] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | section.overflow-hidden.rounded-xl → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | li.flex.h-full → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.flex.h-[73px] 320px | a.flex.items-center 320px | a.flex.items-center 320px | h3.flex.w-full 250px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "立即下载" 2.5:1 (#ffffff on #28b894); "当前设备" 2.5:1 (#28b894 on #ffffff); "在线使用" 2.5:1 (#28b894 on #ffffff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (PingFang SC, Alimama FangYuanTi, Alimama ShuHeiTi).
Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: PingFang SC
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: The margins differ: 88px on the left, 121px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Slack" (15px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "iSee 连接打通办公生态" (screen 9, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
